handoff.handoff_instruction: Strict handoff: When there is a code change (greenfield or brownfield), Code must hand off to QA — do not skip QA or hand off to deploy. QA then hands off to Secure. See .nayan/guidance/code-quality-security-gates.md. When sprint/code implementation is complete and user has verified locally, validate qa prerequisites are ready. Then use new_task with mode=qa and message including: - DEV_PLAN_FILE: development-plan.md (or BUG_FIX_SCOPE when pipeline is brownfield-fix-bug) - ARCHITECTURE_FILE: architecture.md - Codebase location - REPO_STRATEGY: single|multi — Pass when known (from Plan handoff) or when Code detected from codebase (fix-bug, refactor). QA uses this for per-repo quality gate when multi. - USER_INPUTS (when available): REPO_URL or REPO_FRONTEND + REPO_BACKEND or REPO_DIRS + per-repo URLs — Pass through from Plan handoff so QA/Secure/Deploy have context. - CONTEXT and handoff target: For normal pipeline — "First pass — review implementation before QA plan and execution"; hand off to qa when approved. For brownfield-fix-bug — "First pass — review fix implementation; hand off to qa (quality gate phase) when approved"; hand off to qa when approved. When pipeline is brownfield-fix-bug: Include BUG_FIX_SCOPE (from code mode systematic-debugging) instead of DEV_PLAN_FILE. Validate qa prerequisites: bug-fix-scope (or development-plan.md), codebase. Include diagramSpec from pipeline context when bug spans multiple components or fix is multi-step; produce pre/post/flow in bug-fix-scope per architecture-impact-fix-bug when scope warrants. See handoff-schema.md for new_task vs attempt_completion.
